data.body: **[P2] Preserve registration-order startup context.** Creating every plugin before any `onInvocationStart` hook means later factories—including the OTel factories, which capture `Span.current()` in their constructors—cannot observe per-invocation context installed by an earlier plugin's start hook. This can mis-parent or mis-sample traces. Interleave creation with startup hooks, or defer OTel context initialization until its start hook with safe publication; update the ordering test to assert propagation.
